Content-Security-Policy.description: Protects against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.

X-Frame-Options.description: Protects against Clickjacking attacks by forbidding iframe framing.

Referrer-Policy.description: Governs how much referrer information should be included with requests.

Permissions-Policy.description: Restricts browser features like camera, microphone, and geolocation.

Environment Config (.env) Exposure.remediation: Block access to hidden files (.*) and move configuration files outside web root.

Git Repository Metadata Exposure (.git/c.remediation: Deny web server access to .git directories.

Exposed Spring Boot Actuator Endpoint.remediation: Set management.endpoints.web.exposure.exclude=* or bind actuator to localhost.

Swagger / OpenAPI UI Public Exposure.remediation: Restrict API documentation to authenticated developers.

Exposed Database & Source Code Backup Du.remediation: Delete public backup archives and configure web server to deny access to .sql, .tar.gz, .zip, and .bak files.

Robots.txt Sensitive Endpoint Informatio.remediation: Do not rely on robots.txt for security. Protect private administration endpoints using proper authorization gates.

Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 Path Traversal.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or later.

Grafana 8.x Directory Traversal (CVE-202.remediation: Upgrade Grafana to version 8.3.1 or newer.

JetBrains TeamCity Auth Bypass (CVE-2024.remediation: Upgrade TeamCity to version 2023.11.4 or install security patch plugin.

ScreenConnect SetupWizard Auth Bypass (C.remediation: Upgrade ConnectWise ScreenConnect to version 23.9.8 or higher.

MinIO Information Disclosure & Secret Le.remediation: Upgrade MinIO to RELEASE.2023-03-20T20-16-18Z or newer.

F5 BIG-IP TMUI Path Traversal (CVE-2020-.remediation: Apply F5 security hotfixes or restrict TMUI access.

Oracle WebLogic Console Path Traversal (.remediation: Apply Oracle Critical Patch Update or block /console access.

Ollama LLM Framework Unauthenticated API.remediation: Bind Ollama to 127.0.0.1 or enforce mTLS reverse proxy authentication.
